verdict.rationale: Orama has a live llms.txt confirmed by direct probe (HTTP 200 with structured docs index) plus a full llms-full.txt referenced in docs, giving agents machine-readable documentation to consume directly. missing for 10: no independent third-party evidence of an agent successfully using llms.txt end-to-end, and no explicit mention of llms.txt discoverability being advertised as a feature (found via probe rather than docs marketing).
